children: Global credit risks are increasingly being shaped by the prospect of an AI-driven market correction and persistent Middle East geopolitical uncertainty affecting funding conditions, Fitch Ratings says. Credit resilience remains, but slowing U.S. consumer momentum, inflation risks and fiscal constraints could amplify shocks and pressure credit quality, the ratings firm says. Global bond yields have climbed as renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities lift oil prices and increase inflation concerns, with the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield recently reaching its highest level since 2023.
